newsitem.title: USA: Mobile America says president McCorkle to retire.
newsitem.headline: Mobile America says president McCorkle to retire.

text.p: Mobile America Corp said in a statement Thursday that President and Chairman Allan McCorkle intends to retire effective no later than March 1.
The company appointed Jerry Shroat as president and chief operating officer of the company effective July 21.
Shroat most recently has been with Great American Insurance Co as president of its personal lines division.
McCorkle will continue as chairman of the board and chief executive officer and will be working with Shroat through the next six to nine months in order to accomplish a smooth transition.
Mobile provides life, property casualty, health and accident insurance.
